jobs.description:
The role will lead the global development and execution of the global brand communications strategy for Tryngolza , ensuring strong, compliant, and impactful communication.
 Partnering across Brand Marketing, Corporate Communications, Medical, Community Engagement, Investor Relations, Regulatory, Compliance, Legal and Finance, plus regional teams and affiliate teams, you’ll translate strategy into high quality, scalable activation while strengthening global visibility, media impact, and affiliate execution.
 This is a senior individual contributor leadership role designed to own brand communications and lead critical workstreams, in close collaboration with the overall asset leadership team.
 Key responsibilities :
 Strategic Leadership & Brand Communications,

• Lead the global brand communications strategy, including launch readiness, data milestone planning, and lifecycle communications

• Maintain the brand narrative consistently across all channels and stakeholders
 Media Strategy, Relationship & External Engagement

• Partner with Disease State Awareness lead on product media strategy, including channel selection, prioritization, and media investment (paid, earned, and owned)

• Build and manage relationships with key international and specialty media

• Guide affiliates in local media engagement, ensuring consistency, compliance, and quality
 Congress Communications & Activation

• Lead the brand congress communications roadmap (pre-, during-, and post-congress)

• Oversee development of global congress toolkits and ensure strong local amplification across markets

• Coordinate Support cross-functional alignment (Medical, IR, Compliance) for data communication and own media engagement
 Global-to-Local Execution & Affiliate Enablement

• Develop and deploy global communication toolkits, digital assets, and campaign playbooks for affiliate use

• Oversee development of high-quality communication materials, including narratives, Q&As, digital content, and presentations

• Partner closely with country teams to strengthen capabilities and drive high-quality execution

• Lead agency management, ensuring strategic alignment, quality delivery, and efficient execution
 Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner with Medical and Brand teams to ensure scientific integrity and strong educational impact

• Collaborate with Community Engagement to amplify the patient voice and strengthen external partnerships

• Align with Corporate/IR Communications to ensure consistency and clarity of external messaging
 Insights, Performance & Continuous Improvement

• Lead global insight gathering (media landscape, social listening, advisory boards) to inform strategy

• Define and track KPIs to measure communication effectiveness and optimize impact

• Continuously refine communication approaches based on data, insights, and evolving market dynamics
 Capability Building & Innovation

• Drive continuous improvement of communications capabilities across international markets

• Introduce and scale best practices data-driven communications and promote the use of new tools, including AI, to enhance efficiency, personalization, and impact
 Budget, Governance & Compliance
 Manage the budget for communication programs; forecast, track ROI, and reallocate for impact while operating to SOPs, industry codes, and corporate values

• Proven experience in brand communications/PR within healthcare, including significant experience in pharmaceutical or biotech environment.

• Demonstrated success in leading complex, multi-market communications strategies at regional or global level.

• Strong strategic mindset with the ability to translate business priorities into impactful communications and reputation initiatives.

• Proven ability to work cross‑functionally, lead without authority, and manage complexity.

• Strong relationship builder, capable of fostering trusted partnerships across functions (Commercial, Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, Policy, Patient Advocacy) and across country affiliates.

• Excellent communication and influence across functions, cultures, and seniority levels; fluent in English.

• Excellent judgment and decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

• High energy, creativity, agility and a proactive, solutions‑orientated mindset.

• Strong team player with the ability to work independently while maintaining high accuracy and accountability.

• Proficiency with approval systems and compliant content workflows (e.g., Veeva).

• Proficiency in digital and modern communication tools; familiarity with AI-enabled content development within company policies is an asset

• Travel requirement approximately 20% of working time

Il ruolo guiderà lo sviluppo globale e l'esecuzione della strategia di comunicazione globale del marchio per Tryngolza, garantendo una comunicazione forte, conforme e di grande impatto. Collaborando con brand marketing, comunicazioni aziendali, medicina, coinvolgimento della comunità, relazioni con gli investitori, regolamentazione, conformità, legale e finanza, oltre a team regionali e team di affiliazione, tradurrai la strategia in attivazione scalabile e di alta qualità, rafforzando al contempo la visibilità globale, l'impatto sui media e l'esecuzione degli affiliati. Si tratta di un ruolo di leadership di collaboratore senior progettato per possedere le comunicazioni del marchio e guidare flussi di lavoro critici, in stretta collaborazione con il team di leadership delle risorse complessivo. Responsabilità principali: Leadership strategica e comunicazioni del marchio,
• Guidare la strategia di comunicazione globale del marchio, inclusa la preparazione al lancio, la pianificazione dei dati fondamentali e le comunicazioni del ciclo di vita
• Mantenere la narrativa del marchio in modo coerente su tutti i canali e le parti interessate Strategia mediatica, relazioni e coinvolgimento esterno
• Collaborare con il responsabile della consapevolezza dello stato di malattia sulla strategia mediatica del prodotto, inclusa la selezione dei canali, la definizione delle priorità e gli investimenti nei media (pagato, guadagnato e di proprietà)
• Costruire e gestire relazioni con i principali media internazionali e specializzati
• Guidare gli affiliati nel coinvolgimento dei media locali, garantendo coerenza, conformità e qualità del congresso Comunicazioni e attivazione
• Guidare la roadmap delle comunicazioni del congresso del marchio (pre, durante e post-congresso)
• Supervisionare lo sviluppo di toolkit congressuali globali e garantire una forte amplificazione locale nei mercati
• Coordinare il supporto dell'allineamento interfunzionale (medico, IR, conformità) per la comunicazione dei dati e il coinvolgimento dei propri media Esecuzione da globale a locale e abilitazione degli affiliati
• Sviluppare e distribuire toolkit di comunicazione globale, risorse digitali e playbook della campagna per l'utilizzo da parte degli affiliati
• Supervisionare lo sviluppo di una comunicazione di alta qualità materiali, inclusi resoconti, domande e risposte, contenuti digitali e presentazioni
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team nazionali per rafforzare le capacità e promuovere un'esecuzione di alta qualità
• Guidare la gestione dell'agenzia, garantendo allineamento strategico, fornitura di qualità ed esecuzione efficiente Collaborazione interfunzionale
• Collaborare con i team medici e del marchio per garantire integrità scientifica e un forte impatto educativo
• Collaborare con il coinvolgimento della comunità per amplificare la voce dei pazienti e rafforzare le partnership esterne
• Allinearsi con le comunicazioni aziendali/IR per garantire coerenza e chiarezza della messaggistica esterna Approfondimenti, prestazioni e miglioramento continuo
• Guidare insight globali raccolta (panorama dei media, ascolto sociale, comitati consultivi) per informare la strategia
• Definire e tenere traccia dei KPI per misurare l'efficacia della comunicazione e ottimizzare l'impatto
• Perfezionare continuamente gli approcci di comunicazione basati su dati, approfondimenti e dinamiche di mercato in evoluzione Capability Building e innovazione
• Promuovere il miglioramento continuo delle capacità di comunicazione nei mercati internazionali
• Introdurre e ampliare le migliori pratiche di comunicazione basate sui dati e promuovere l'uso di nuovi strumenti, inclusa l'intelligenza artificiale, per migliorare l'efficienza, la personalizzazione e l'impatto Budget, governance e conformità Gestire il budget per i programmi di comunicazione; prevedere, monitorare il ROI e riallocare l'impatto operando in base a SOP, codici di settore e valori aziendali.
• Comprovata esperienza nelle comunicazioni/PR del marchio nel settore sanitario, inclusa una significativa esperienza in ambiente farmaceutico o biotecnologico.
• Dimostrato successo nella conduzione di strategie di comunicazione complesse e multimercato a livello regionale o globale.
• Forte mentalità strategica con la capacità di tradurre le priorità aziendali in iniziative di comunicazione e reputazione di grande impatto.
• Comprovata capacità di lavorare in modo interfunzionale, guidare senza autorità e gestire la complessità.
• Forte costruttore di relazioni, in grado di promuovere partenariati di fiducia tra le funzioni (commerciale, medica, accesso al mercato, regolamentazione, politica, tutela dei pazienti) e le filiali in tutti i paesi.
• Eccellente comunicazione e influenza tra funzioni, culture e livelli di anzianità; fluente in inglese.
• Eccellenti capacità di giudizio e decisionali, con la capacità di stabilire le priorità in ambienti dinamici e frenetici.
• Alta energia, creatività, agilità e una mentalità proattiva e orientata alle soluzioni.
• Forte giocatore di squadra con la capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente pur mantenendo elevata precisione e responsabilità.
• Competenza con i sistemi di approvazione e i flussi di lavoro dei contenuti conformi (ad esempio, Veeva).
• Competenza negli strumenti di comunicazione digitali e moderni; la familiarità con lo sviluppo di contenuti abilitati all'intelligenza artificiale nell'ambito delle politiche aziendali è una risorsa
• Necessità di viaggio pari a circa il 20% dell'orario di lavoro

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Rolle wird die globale Entwicklung und Umsetzung der globalen Markenkommunikationsstrategie für Tryngolza leiten und eine starke, konforme und wirkungsvolle Kommunikation gewährleisten. Durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Markenmarketing, Unternehmenskommunikation, Medizin, Community-Engagement, Investor Relations, Regulierung, Compliance, Recht und Finanzen sowie regionalen Teams und Affiliate-Teams setzen Sie Ihre Strategie in hochwertige, skalierbare Aktivierung um und stärken gleichzeitig die globale Sichtbarkeit, Medienwirkung und Affiliate-Umsetzung. Hierbei handelt es sich um eine leitende, individuelle Führungsrolle, die darauf ausgelegt ist, die Markenkommunikation zu verantworten und wichtige Arbeitsabläufe in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem gesamten Asset-Führungsteam zu leiten. Hauptaufgaben: Strategische Führung und Markenkommunikation,
• Leitung der globalen Markenkommunikationsstrategie, einschließlich Markteinführungsbereitschaft, Planung von Datenmeilensteinen und Lebenszykluskommunikation,
• Konsistente Pflege des Markennarrativs über alle Kanäle und Stakeholder hinweg, Medienstrategie, Beziehung und externes Engagement,
• Partnerschaft mit Disease State Awareness, Leitung der Produktmedienstrategie, einschließlich Kanalauswahl, Priorisierung und Medieninvestitionen (bezahlt, verdient und im Besitz).
• Aufbau und Verwaltung von Beziehungen zu wichtigen internationalen und Spezialmedien Hochwertige Kongresskommunikation und -aktivierung
• Leiten Sie die Marken-Kongresskommunikations-Roadmap (vor, während und nach dem Kongress)
• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Entwicklung globaler Kongress-Toolkits und stellen Sie eine starke lokale Verstärkung in allen Märkten sicher
• Koordinieren Sie die funktionsübergreifende Ausrichtung (Medizin, IR, Compliance) für die Datenkommunikation und das eigene Medienengagement Global-to-Local-Ausführung und Affiliate-Enablement
• Entwickeln und implementieren Sie globale Kommunikations-Toolkits, digitale Assets und Kampagnen-Playbooks für den Affiliate-Einsatz
• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Entwicklung hochwertiger Kommunikationsmaterialien, einschließlich Erzählungen, Fragen und Antworten, digitale Inhalte und Präsentationen
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit den Länderteams zusammen, um Fähigkeiten zu stärken und eine qualitativ hochwertige Ausführung voranzutreiben.
• Führen Sie das Agenturmanagement und stellen Sie die strategische Ausrichtung, Qualitätsbereitstellung und effiziente Ausführung sicher. Funktionsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit.
• Arbeiten Sie mit medizinischen und Markenteams zusammen, um wissenschaftliche Integrität und starke pädagogische Wirkung sicherzustellen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Community Engagement zusammen, um die Stimme der Patienten zu verstärken und externe Partnerschaften zu stärken.
• Stimmen Sie sich mit der Unternehmens-/IR-Kommunikation ab, um Konsistenz und Klarheit der externen Nachrichten sicherzustellen. Einblicke, Leistung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung.
• Leiten Sie globale Einblicke Sammeln (Medienlandschaft, Social Listening, Beratungsgremien), um die Strategie zu informieren.
• Definieren und verfolgen Sie KPIs, um die Wirksamkeit der Kommunikation zu messen und die Wirkung zu optimieren.
• Kontinuierliche Verfeinerung von Kommunikationsansätzen auf der Grundlage von Daten, Erkenntnissen und sich entwickelnden Marktdynamiken. Kompetenzaufbau und Innovation.
• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auf internationalen Märkten vorantreiben. Prognostizieren, verfolgen Sie den ROI und verteilen Sie die Auswirkungen neu, während Sie sich an SOPs, Branchenkodizes und Unternehmenswerte halten.
• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Markenkommunikation/PR im Gesundheitswesen, einschließlich umfangreicher Erfahrung im Pharma- oder Biotech-Umfeld.
• Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Leitung komplexer, marktübergreifender Kommunikationsstrategien auf regionaler oder globaler Ebene.
• Starke strategische Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, Geschäftsprioritäten in wirkungsvolle Kommunikations- und Reputationsinitiativen umzusetzen.
• Nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifend zu arbeiten, ohne Autorität zu führen und Komplexität zu bewältigen.
• Starker Beziehungsaufbau, der in der Lage ist, vertrauenswürdige Partnerschaften über alle Funktionen hinweg (kommerziell, medizinisch, Marktzugang, Regulierung, Politik, Patientenvertretung) und über Länderpartner hinweg zu fördern.
• Hervorragende Kommunikation und Einfluss über alle Funktionen, Kulturen und Dienstaltersstufen hinweg; fließend Englisch.
• Hervorragende Urteils- und Entscheidungsfähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, in dynamischen, schnelllebigen Umgebungen Prioritäten zu setzen.
• Hohe Energie, Kreativität, Agilität und eine proaktive, lösungsorientierte Denkweise.
• Starker Teamplayer mit der Fähigkeit, unabhängig zu arbeiten und gleichzeitig hohe Genauigkeit und Verantwortungsbewusstsein zu wahren.
• Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Genehmigungssystemen und konformen Content-Workflows (z. B. Veeva).
• Kenntnisse im Umgang mit digitalen und modernen Kommunikationsmitteln; Vertrautheit mit der KI-gestützten Inhaltsentwicklung im Rahmen der Unternehmensrichtlinien ist von Vorteil.
• Reiseaufwand ca. 20 % der Arbeitszeit
descriptionByLocale.fr:

En travaillant en partenariat avec le marketing de marque, les communications d'entreprise, les services médicaux, l'engagement communautaire, les relations avec les investisseurs, la réglementation, la conformité, les affaires juridiques et financières, ainsi que les équipes régionales et les équipes d'affiliation, vous traduirez la stratégie en une activation évolutive de haute qualité tout en renforçant la visibilité mondiale, l'impact médiatique et l'exécution des affiliations. Il s'agit d'un rôle de leadership de contributeur individuel senior conçu pour s'approprier les communications de la marque et diriger les flux de travail critiques, en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe globale de direction des actifs. Principales responsabilités : Leadership stratégique et communications de marque,
• Diriger la stratégie mondiale de communication de la marque, y compris la préparation au lancement, la planification des étapes de données et les communications du cycle de vie.
• Maintenir le récit de la marque de manière cohérente sur tous les canaux et parties prenantes. Stratégie médiatique, relations et engagement externe.
• Collaborer avec le responsable de la sensibilisation à l'état de la maladie sur la stratégie médiatique des produits, y compris la sélection des canaux, la priorisation et l'investissement dans les médias (payés, gagnés et détenus).
• Établir et gérer des relations avec les principaux médias internationaux et spécialisés. Diriger la feuille de route des communications de la marque au congrès (avant, pendant et après le congrès)
• Superviser le développement de boîtes à outils du congrès mondial et assurer une forte amplification locale sur tous les marchés
• Coordonner le soutien à l'alignement interfonctionnel (médical, IR, conformité) pour la communication des données et l'engagement des médias. Questions et réponses, contenu numérique et présentations
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes nationales pour renforcer les capacités et assurer une exécution de haute qualité
• Diriger la gestion de l'agence, garantissant l'alignement stratégique, la qualité et l'exécution efficace Collaboration interfonctionnelle
• Collaborer avec les équipes médicales et de marque pour garantir l'intégrité scientifique et un fort impact éducatif
• Collaborer avec l'engagement communautaire pour amplifier la voix des patients et renforcer les partenariats externes
• S'aligner sur les communications d'entreprise/RI pour assurer la cohérence et la clarté des messages externes Informations, performances et amélioration continue
• Diriger la collecte d'informations mondiales (paysage médiatique, écoute sociale, conseils consultatifs) pour éclairer la stratégie
• Définir et suivre les KPI pour mesurer l'efficacité de la communication et optimiser l'impact
• Affiner continuellement les approches de communication basées sur les données, les informations et l'évolution de la dynamique du marché Renforcement des capacités et innovation
• Favoriser l'amélioration continue des capacités de communication sur les marchés internationaux
• Introduire et mettre à l'échelle les meilleures pratiques de communication basées sur les données et promouvoir l'utilisation de nouveaux outils, y compris l'IA, pour améliorer l'efficacité, la personnalisation et l'impact Budget, gouvernance et conformité Gérer le budget des programmes de communication ; prévoir, suivre le retour sur investissement et réaffecter l'impact tout en opérant selon les SOP, les codes de l'industrie et les valeurs de l'entreprise.
• Expérience avérée en communication de marque/RP dans le secteur de la santé, y compris une expérience significative dans un environnement pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique.
• Succès démontré dans la direction de stratégies de communication complexes et multi-marchés au niveau régional ou mondial.
• Fort esprit stratégique avec la capacité de traduire les priorités commerciales en initiatives de communication et de réputation percutantes.
• Capacité avérée à travailler de manière interfonctionnelle, à diriger sans autorité et à gérer la complexité.
• Solide bâtisseur de relations, capable de favoriser des partenariats de confiance entre les fonctions (commercial, médical, accès au marché, réglementation, politique, défense des patients) et entre les filiales nationales.
• Excellente communication et influence à travers les fonctions, les cultures et les niveaux d'ancienneté ; parle couramment l'anglais.
• Excellentes compétences de jugement et de prise de décision, avec la capacité d'établir des priorités dans des environnements dynamiques et en évolution rapide.
• Beaucoup d'énergie, de créativité, d'agilité et un état d'esprit proactif et axé sur les solutions.
• Fort esprit d'équipe avec la capacité de travailler de manière indépendante tout en maintenant une grande précision et responsabilité.
• Maîtrise des systèmes d'approbation et des flux de travail de contenu conformes (par exemple, Veeva).
• Maîtrise des outils de communication numériques et modernes ; une connaissance du développement de contenu basé sur l'IA dans le cadre des politiques de l'entreprise est un atout.
• Déplacements requis environ 20 % du temps de travail

jobs.description:
The IT department, a part of IS/IT, are responsible for architecture, strategy, maintenance and support of Sobi information systems and IT infrastructure as clients, servers, network and other infrastructure equipment.
 The IT department consist of four teams – IT Operations, Infrastructure & Cyber security, Digital Workplace and Automation & Integration.All IT activities are performed in accordance with Sobi’s quality framework (GxP) and applicable regulatory and authority requirements.
 Within this context, the Digital Workplace & AI function plays a key role in enabling secure, compliant, and scalable digital solutions across Sobi. Under the leadership of the Head of Digital Workplace & AI, the team is responsible for developing and advancing Sobi’s Digital Workplace, Microsoft 365 platform, and enterprise AI capabilities. This includes setting strategic direction, defining objectives, and delivering modern, AI-enabled tools that support collaboration, productivity, and innovation across the organization.
 Main responsibilities:

• Develop and maintain enterprise-grade AI applications built on Azure OpenAI, including chat interfaces, document processing pipelines (RAG), and real-time collaboration features

• Design and implement Azure cloud solutions leveraging Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Cognitive Search, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Document Intelligence, and Azure AI Search

• Build and optimize full-stack applications using Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, and modern frontend/backend patterns (App Router, Server Components, Server Actions)

• Optimize AI/LLM integrations, including prompt engineering, token management, streaming completions, and multi-model AI orchestration

• Ensure code quality, security, and compliance through code reviews, testing, documentation, and adherence to Sobi's quality framework (GxP)

• Work proactively with ServiceNow to resolve incoming bug reports and other issues

• 4+ years of professional experience working as a software developer

• React / Next JS / Typescript / Azure Knowledge

• Proven ability to work autonomously and take ownership of features from concept to deployment

• Hands-on experience with Azure cloud services (Cosmos DB, Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Search, Blob Storage)

• Experience building and maintaining full-stack applications in production environment

• AI / LLM / Agent experience

• Fluent in English (written and spoken)
 Ideally you bring also:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience)

• Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, or regulated industries preferred

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Emphasis on work/life balance

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments
 We are a global company with over 1,800 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. By effectively turning our research into ground-breaking treatments, we help make medicine more accessible and open up more possibilities for patients and more opportunities for those caring for them. This has been our approach since day one, but we know we can’t change the world of rare diseases on our own. Accomplishing this requires strong partnerships with patients, partners and stakeholders across the entire value chain. jobs.description:
The Medicine Development Leader (MDL) has the overall accountability for developing, driving and representing the clinical development strategy for the nephrology program within the Core Asset Team (CAT), including benefit/risk evaluation, pharmacovigilance (PV) and safety. The MDL leads the Medicine Development Team (MDT) and assures, in close collaboration with the TA head, the appropriate communication flow between the CAT, the MDT and other associated teams (e.g. the Study Team).
 Key Responsibilities

• Drives the clinical development strategy for the assigned compound(s) across the medicine lifecycle, from proof of concept to successful global regulatory approval(s)/market access for multiple treatment indications.

• Provides clinical and scientific expertise to set and execute the asset strategy and optimize project success.

• Works with functional members, TA head and CAT Leaders to develop Integrated Project Plans (IPP) documents.

• Identifies risks for the program with other functions and develops mitigation strategies to address them.

• Presents the nephrology clinical program to internal (including the CEO and the Executive Committee of the Organisation) and external stakeholders (Health Authorities, Steering Committees, Independent Data Monitoring Committees, and Patient Organisations etc), engages when necessary with Key Opinion Leaders across geographies.

• Is a core member of the benefit risk team (BRT), of regulatory submission teams and of the labeling working group.

• Ensures endorsement of clinical development plans and study documents by Sobi governance bodies (e.g. Sobi Evidence Generation Board, Study Document Review Forum).

• Leads in a matrix the clinical scientists and the Medicine Development Team (consists of representatives from Medical Affairs, Clinical Science, Regulatory, Safety/PV, non-clinical/PK, Biostatistics/Data management, Clinical Program Management, Heath Economics and Outcome Research, RWE, Program Management), providing strategic guidance and being the ultimate accountable for:

• Clinical trial design (clinical study synopsis and protocol development), planning (e.g. sites and countries selection), execution (e.g.medical monitoring, resolution of safety issues; interpretation of statistical analyses) and internal and external communication of study results

• Creation of clinical components of key documents (Clinical Development Plans, Clinical Study Protocols, Investigator’s Brochures, Clinical Study Reports, regulatory documents including maintenance of product licenses, Clinical Modules of registration dossiers, Briefing Books for interactions with Health Authorities) with high quality and consistency with the Integrated Project Plan and Target Product Profile.

• Provision of required input on clinical efficacy, safety, dosing/administration, mechanism of action, etc for the Target Product Profile (TPP)

• Support to registration and market access (Core Data Sheet, Development Safety Update Report, Periodic Safety Update Report, clinical benefit-risk assessment) o Collaboration with Regulatory team to determine international submission strategy

• Medical degree with 10+ years of relevant clinical experience in academic and/or pharmaceutical Global Research & Development roles

• Solid track record in drug development programmes, preferably within nephrology

• Extensive knowledge of clinical trial methodology, global regulatory requirements, and experience in designing and executing clinical studies

• Advanced knowledge of clinical trial operational aspects, including budget and timeline management

• Demonstrated ability to build and execute strategic and tactical plans

• Experience engaging with key internal and external stakeholders

• Specialty in relevant therapeutic area with at least 5 years clinical experience treating patients and successful interactions with major Health Authorities leading to drug approvals

• Strong leadership skills with demonstrated capability to lead cross-functional teams in a matrix environment

• Ability to coach, mentor, and communicate effectively with all audiences internally and externally

• Excellent organisational skills with self-motivated drive to implement best practices

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate and analyse medical and scientific literature

• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

• Alignment with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership, and Partnership

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Medicine Development Leader (MDL) has the overall accountability for developing, driving and representing the clinical development strategy for the nephrology program within the Core Asset Team (CAT), including benefit/risk evaluation, pharmacovigilance (PV) and safety. The MDL leads the Medicine Development Team (MDT) and assures, in close collaboration with the TA head, the appropriate communication flow between the CAT, the MDT and other associated teams (e.g. the Study Team).
Key Responsibilities

• Drives the clinical development strategy for the assigned compound(s) across the medicine lifecycle, from proof of concept to successful global regulatory approval(s)/market access for multiple treatment indications.

• Provides clinical and scientific expertise to set and execute the asset strategy and optimize project success.

• Works with functional members, TA head and CAT Leaders to develop Integrated Project Plans (IPP) documents.

• Identifies risks for the program with other functions and develops mitigation strategies to address them.

• Presents the nephrology clinical program to internal (including the CEO and the Executive Committee of the Organisation) and external stakeholders (Health Authorities, Steering Committees, Independent Data Monitoring Committees, and Patient Organisations etc), engages when necessary with Key Opinion Leaders across geographies.

• Is a core member of the benefit risk team (BRT), of regulatory submission teams and of the labeling working group.

• Ensures endorsement of clinical development plans and study documents by Sobi governance bodies (e.g. Sobi Evidence Generation Board, Study Document Review Forum).

• Leads in a matrix the clinical scientists and the Medicine Development Team (consists of representatives from Medical Affairs, Clinical Science, Regulatory, Safety/PV, non-clinical/PK, Biostatistics/Data management, Clinical Program Management, Heath Economics and Outcome Research, RWE, Program Management), providing strategic guidance and being the ultimate accountable for:

• Clinical trial design (clinical study synopsis and protocol development), planning (e.g. sites and countries selection), execution (e.g.medical monitoring, resolution of safety issues; interpretation of statistical analyses) and internal and external communication of study results

• Creation of clinical components of key documents (Clinical Development Plans, Clinical Study Protocols, Investigator’s Brochures, Clinical Study Reports, regulatory documents including maintenance of product licenses, Clinical Modules of registration dossiers, Briefing Books for interactions with Health Authorities) with high quality and consistency with the Integrated Project Plan and Target Product Profile.

• Provision of required input on clinical efficacy, safety, dosing/administration, mechanism of action, etc for the Target Product Profile (TPP)

• Support to registration and market access (Core Data Sheet, Development Safety Update Report, Periodic Safety Update Report, clinical benefit-risk assessment) o Collaboration with Regulatory team to determine international submission strategy

• Medical degree with 10+ years of relevant clinical experience in academic and/or pharmaceutical Global Research & Development roles

• Solid track record in drug development programmes, preferably within nephrology

• Extensive knowledge of clinical trial methodology, global regulatory requirements, and experience in designing and executing clinical studies

• Advanced knowledge of clinical trial operational aspects, including budget and timeline management

• Demonstrated ability to build and execute strategic and tactical plans

• Experience engaging with key internal and external stakeholders

• Specialty in relevant therapeutic area with at least 5 years clinical experience treating patients and successful interactions with major Health Authorities leading to drug approvals

• Strong leadership skills with demonstrated capability to lead cross-functional teams in a matrix environment

• Ability to coach, mentor, and communicate effectively with all audiences internally and externally

• Excellent organisational skills with self-motivated drive to implement best practices

• Demonstrated ability to evaluate and analyse medical and scientific literature

• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

• Alignment with Sobi's core values: Care, Ambition, Urgency, Ownership, and Partnership

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
Product-level safety ownership

• Perform and lead signal detection, evaluation, validation and escalation activities for assigned product(s).

• Set the strategy for safety signal detection methodology, signal tracking and oversight of safety signals for assigned products.

• Drive, perform and document benefit‑risk evaluations and ensure appropriate risk‑management strategies are implemented.

• Lead and perform assessments for the preparation, review and approval of key safety deliverables (e.g. PSURs, DSURs, RMPs, regulatory responses).

• Translate safety data insights into actionable recommendations for product‑level benefit–risk discussions and regulatory interactions.

• Lead the clinical safety science interactions with partner companies for the assigned products (if applicable) ensuring sharing of safety information per the SDEA and the set up and collaborative functioning of the JSMT.

• Provide safety scientific input to ISS Evaluation Committee as required.

• In case of product quality escalations, work cross functionally to understand impacts on patients, and (if required) lead the preparation of a medical impact Health Hazard Assessment statement.

Cross-functional execution (MDT)

• Act as the Safety Science representative in the Medical Development Team (MDT) and ensure integration of safety into product development and lifecycle decisions.

• Provide clinical safety input into study design, conduct, analysis and interpretation, including study‑level Safety Lead responsibilities where applicable.

• Provide medical and pharmacovigilance expertise e.g. for the clinical safety strategy of the product clinical development program, the development of the Target Product Profile (TPP), the development and maintenance of the RSI, including IB and CDS

Governance and decision-making

• Chair product‑level Benefit Risk Teams (BRTs) and ensure effective operation per SOPs.

• Represent the BRT at Benefit Risk Council (BRC).

• Serve as the primary decision-maker for product-level safety issues, including signal validation and escalation.

Collaboration and delivery

• Lead interactions with external partners and service providers related to assigned product safety deliverables.

• Support regulatory interactions, inspections and audits at product level.

People and capability development

• Mentor colleagues and support capability development within the product safety team.

Continuous improvement & data-driven decision making

• Actively use and continuously develop proficiency in safety systems, data visualization tools, and AI‑enabled analyses (e.g. Veeva Vault(s), analytics dashboards) to support robust and efficient signal detection, safety assessments, and decision‑making for assigned products.

• Identify opportunities for process, data and system improvements within Safety Science.

Level of autonomy: works independently with accountability for assigned products, escalating complex or cross‑product issues as appropriate.

Education/Learning Experience/Work Experience
 Required:

• MD, PharmD, PhD or Master’s in Life Sciences/Public Health

• Solid experience in pharmacovigilance and safety science within a pharmaceutical or regulatory environment

• Strong knowledge of global PV regulations (e.g., GVP, ICH E2E), pharmacovigilance processes and practices

• Proficiency to analyse, synthesize medical & scientific safety data and contribute to scientific interpretation

• Strong communication & stakeholder collaboration skills

• Proficiency in Excel, database querying (e.g., SQL), and basic data visualization (e.g., Power BI, Spotfire), AI-related tools

• Experience working with development programs and with products with market approvals

• Experience leading cross functional global product safety management teams, successfully delivering medical safety strategy, with experience across safety signal process, aggregate report writing, safety risk communication and safety risk management

Desired:

• Experience working with partner companies to successfully develop and market products across global markets

• Experience presenting medical safety information at Health Authority meetings

• Demonstrated expertise in the understanding, interpretation, and application of various country/regional pharmacovigilance requirements

Skills/Knowledge/Languages
 Required:

• High quality written and spoken English

• Strong analytical skills

• Effective communicator (oral, writing, presentations) at all levels of the business

• Ability to work effectively to fulfil ambitious goals

• Sound and balanced judgment skills; able to assess and handle risks; self-confident, proactive and decisive

• Demonstrated ability to lead safety activities and scientific discussions

• Strong team-leadership capabilities. Demonstrated relationship builder both internally and externally; a strong collaborator within PV function, leadership and the wider organisation

descriptionByLocale.it:
Proprietà della sicurezza a livello di prodotto
• Eseguire e condurre le attività di rilevamento, valutazione, convalida e escalation del segnale per i prodotti assegnati.
• Impostare la strategia per la metodologia di rilevamento del segnale di sicurezza, il monitoraggio del segnale e la supervisione dei segnali di sicurezza per i prodotti assegnati.
• Guidare, eseguire e documentare valutazioni a rischio e garantire appropriate strategie di gestione del rischio.
• Guidare ed eseguire valutazioni per la preparazione, la revisione e l'approvazione dei portabili di sicurezza chiave (ad esempio PSURs, DSURs, RMP, risposte normative).
• Traduci informazioni sui dati di sicurezza nelle raccomandazioni attuabili per le discussioni sui benefici a livello di prodotto e le interazioni normative.
• Guidare le interazioni cliniche della scienza della sicurezza con le aziende partner per i prodotti assegnati (se applicabile) garantendo la condivisione delle informazioni di sicurezza per la SDEA e il funzionamento impostato e collaborativo del JSMT.
• Fornire input scientifici di sicurezza al Comitato di valutazione ISS come richiesto.
• In caso di escalation di qualità del prodotto, il lavoro si incrocia funzionalmente per comprendere gli impatti sui pazienti, e (se necessario) condurre la preparazione di un impatto medico Health Hazard Valutazione. Esecuzione trasversale (MDT)
• Agire come rappresentante della scienza di sicurezza nel team di sviluppo medico (MDT) e garantire l'integrazione della sicurezza nelle decisioni di sviluppo del prodotto e del ciclo di vita.
• Fornire input di sicurezza clinica nella progettazione, nella condotta, nell'analisi e nell'interpretazione, comprese le responsabilità del piombo di sicurezza a livello di studio ove applicabile.
• Fornire competenze mediche e farmacovigilanza, ad esempio per la strategia di sicurezza clinica del programma di sviluppo clinico del prodotto, lo sviluppo del profilo del prodotto target (TPP), lo sviluppo e la manutenzione del RSI, tra cui IB e CDS Governance e processo decisionale
• Sedia a livello di prodotto Benefit Risk Teams (BRTs) e garantire un funzionamento efficace per le SOP.
• Rappresentare la BRT al Benefit Risk Council (BRC).
• Servire come primo decisore per problemi di sicurezza a livello di prodotto, tra cui la convalida del segnale e l'escalation. Collaborazione e consegna
• Interazioni di piombo con partner esterni e fornitori di servizi relativi ai fornitori di sicurezza dei prodotti assegnati.
• Supporta interazioni, ispezioni e audit normativi a livello di prodotto. Sviluppo delle persone e delle capacità
• Collaboratori e sviluppo delle capacità di supporto all'interno del team di sicurezza del prodotto. Miglioramento continuo e processo decisionale basato sui dati
• Utilizzare attivamente e sviluppare continuamente la competenza nei sistemi di sicurezza, negli strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati e nelle analisi abilitate all'intelligenza artificiale (ad esempio Veeva Vault(s), dashboard di analisi) per supportare il rilevamento dei segnali robusti ed efficienti, le valutazioni di sicurezza e il processo decisionale per i prodotti assegnati.
• Identificare le opportunità per i miglioramenti di processo, dati e sistemi all'interno di Safety Science. Livello di autonomia: funziona in modo indipendente con responsabilità per i prodotti assegnati, aumentando i problemi complessi o cross-product come appropriato. Esperienza di formazione/apprendimento/esperienza di lavoro Richiesto:
• MD, PharmD, PhD o Master in Scienze della Vita / Salute Pubblica
• Esperienza solida nella farmacovigilanza e nella scienza della sicurezza in un ambiente farmaceutico o normativo
• Forte conoscenza delle normative PV globali (ad esempio, GVP, ICH E2E), processi e pratiche di farmacovigilanza
• Capacità di analizzare, sintetizzare dati di sicurezza medica e scientifica e contribuire all'interpretazione scientifica
• Forte capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione degli stakeholder
• Proficienza in Excel, querying del database (ad esempio, SQL) e visualizzazione dei dati di base (ad esempio, Power BI, Spotfire), strumenti correlati all'AI
• Esperienza di lavoro con programmi di sviluppo e con prodotti con approvazioni di mercato
• Esperienza leader tra i team di gestione della sicurezza dei prodotti globali funzionali, offrendo con successo la strategia di sicurezza medica, con esperienza nel processo di segnale di sicurezza, scrittura di report aggregati, comunicazione dei rischi di sicurezza e gestione dei rischi di sicurezza Desired:
• Esperienza di lavoro con le aziende partner per sviluppare e commercializzare con successo prodotti su mercati globali
• Esperienza che presenta informazioni sulla sicurezza medica alle riunioni dell'Autorità sanitaria
• Competenza dimostrata nella comprensione, nell'interpretazione e nell'applicazione dei vari requisiti di farmacovigilanza nazionale/regionale Competenze/Knowledge/Languages Richiesto:
• Alta qualità scritto e parlato inglese
• Forte capacità analitiche
• Efficace comunicatore (orale, scrittura, presentazioni) a tutti i livelli del business
• Capacità di lavorare efficacemente per raggiungere obiettivi ambiziosi
• Competenze di giudizio solide ed equilibrate; capaci di valutare e gestire i rischi; autosufficienti, proattive e decisive
• Capacità dimostrata di condurre attività di sicurezza e discussioni scientifiche
• Forte capacità di team-leadership. Dimostrato costruttore di relazioni sia internamente che esternamente; un forte collaboratore all'interno della funzione PV, della leadership e dell'organizzazione più ampia

About the role
 Join Sobi’s Global CMC Science & Technology team and help shape how our medicines are developed and supplied worldwide. We are looking for an Associate Analytical Expert who will play a key role in ensuring the release of Sobi products by coordination of the stock of Critical Analytical Materials used for the release analyses at our Contract Laboratory Organisations (CLOs). By working cross-functionally with colleagues across Sobi and in close partnership with global contract laboratory organizations (CLOs), you will coordinate and monitor the use of Critical Analytical Materials to ensure continuous availability, re-supply, qualification and effective long-term planning.
 In addition, you will be involved in the day-to-day analytical work supporting our products. You will have the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues and gain insight into the business, supply, and lifecycle challenges across our portfolio. Over time, you will build a strong understanding of Sobi’s portfolio and contribute to the continued development of the analytical team.
 This role can be performed remotely within the European time zone and reports to the Group Head of Analytics based at Sobi headquarters in Stockholm.

Key Responsibilities

• Secure continuous control of Critical Analytical Materials needed for release of Sobi products and “tracking” of the use of the stock of the materials.

Examples are Reagents, Standards and Control samples.

• Continuously monitor the stock. Forecast demand, perform stock inventory, create supply plans, order materials, and update stock inventory of critical analytical materials.

• Ensure lifecycle management, compliance, and robustness of Critical Analytical Materials used in analytical methods at CLOs.

• Manage interactions with Sobi’s external partners to ensure continuous delivery of analytical data, protocols, and reports in relation to the Critical Analytical Material.

• Provide analytical expertise across product related activities.

• Contribute to analytical method transfers and support product stability and shelf-life activities through ongoing stability studies.

• Support investigations related to deviations, handling out-of-trend (OOT) and out-of-specification (OOS), as well as handling changes and CAPAs.

• Contribute to identifying, evaluating, and implementing improvements within the analytical team’s ways of working.

Qualifications

• MSc or PhD in analytical chemistry, chemistry, biochemistry, pharmacy, chemical engineering, or related field.

• Experience of life sciences or pharmaceutical industry.

• Knowledge of common QC laboratory analytical methods, such as chromatography, spectroscopy, ELISA, and bioassays.

• Experience working with contract manufacturers and/or contract laboratories (CMOs/CLOs).

• Interest in automation, digital tools, and visualization of large data sets.

• Experience working in a GMP-regulated environment.

• Strong written and spoken English skills are required.

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Emphasis on work/life balance

We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

Sobi Culture

At Sobi, we refuse to accept the status quo. This is because we have witnessed first-hand the challenges facing those affected by rare diseases and have used this knowledge to shape our business to find new ways of helping them.

As a specialized biopharmaceutical company, we are dedicated to rare diseases. And we see this focus as a strength. • Verwalten Sie die Interaktionen mit den externen Partnern von Sobi, um die kontinuierliche Bereitstellung von Analysedaten, Protokollen und Berichten in Bezug auf das kritische Analysematerial sicherzustellen.

• Erfahrung in Life Sciences oder Pharmaindustrie.
• Kenntnisse über gängige QC-Laboranalysemethoden wie Chromatographie, Spektroskopie, ELISA und Bioassays.

Science and Technology (SAT) is part of the Global CMC, Science & Technology Department (GCSAT).
 GCSAT is a growing organization, responsible for optimization and life cycle management of Sobi’s clinical and commercial manufacturing and analytical processes in our external network. SAT ensures compliant, reliable, cost effective and sustainable manufacturing and testing of our products now and in future. The SAT team holds the senior scientific and technical knowledge for the manufacturing and analytical testing of Sobi’s clinical and commercial products and is responsible for always keeping processes in a validated stage.
 The Technical Lead is pivotal in ensuring technical excellence, regulatory compliance, and the continuous improvement of manufacturing processes. The incumbent will drive cross-functional collaboration to support the launch and lifecycle management of products, technology transfers, and the implementation of innovative methodologies
 Main responsibilities:

• Subject matter expert (SME) for DS Biologics manufacturing.

• Process owner of DS Biologics validation for Sobi products.

• Lead and execute MSAT projects such as manufacturing process and cost improvement as part of life-cycle management (LCM).

• Participate in and lead internal activities related to (external) manufacturing such as process changes, major/critical deviations, risk assessments and CAPAs.

• Issue, review and approve applicable internal and external SOP’s and manufacturing instructions.

• Review and supervise set up, execution and documentation of technical studies, qualifications and validations.

• Write and review applicable sections of the APR/PQR.

• Write and review applicable sections in registration files, variations and market expansion, as well as answer Health authorities requests and questions.

• Support in sourcing evaluation of new DS Biologics contract manufacturers and participation in developing supply and quality agreements.

• Lead the process components of the product transfer, scale up activities, validations and oversee manufacturing of DS Biologics processes at external manufacturers for Sobi projects in clinical and commercial phase.

• Be aware of external pharmaceutical manufacturing technology advancements, understand and introduce new technologies and how they may be applicable to process innovation, cost or yield improvement

• Represent SAT in product governance teams as needed, including potentially coordinating the oversight and escalation of DS, DP and Analytical project portfolio.

• Support SAT and Sobi’s continuous improvement program for internal business processes, systems and templates.

• University education in Biology, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or similar.

• +10 years of experience of  manufacturing of DS Biologics for commercial use. Additional experience in clinical manufacturing and process development for clinical and commercial use is a plus.

• Strong background in Upstream Manufacturing (including Cell banking and new working cell bank implementation).  Mammalian Cell culture mainly  and bacterial fermentation a plus.

• Strong understanding of scale down models and their qualification a plus.

• Scientific and technical background of CMC development, product launch is a plus.

• Experience of regulatory guidelines, and regulatory authorities’ communication.

• Demonstrable experience of working in cross functional team with ability to multitask, prioritize and be an effective decision maker

• Ability to thrive in new, unstructured environments and influence without authority.

• Ability to act independently and take initiative

• Good communication skills, oral/written and listening

• Fluent in English.

• Travelling up to 30% of the time.

How to apply
 We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.
 Why Join Us?
 Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Emphasis on work/life balance

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

GCSAT is a growing organization, responsible for optimization and life cycle management of Sobi’s clinical and commercial manufacturing and analytical processes in our external network. SAT ensures compliant, reliable, cost effective and sustainable manufacturing and testing of our products now and in future. The SAT team holds the senior scientific and technical knowledge for the manufacturing and analytical testing of Sobi’s clinical and commercial products and is responsible for always keeping processes in a validated stage.
The Technical Lead is pivotal in ensuring technical excellence, regulatory compliance, and the continuous improvement of manufacturing processes. The incumbent will drive cross-functional collaboration to support the launch and lifecycle management of products, technology transfers, and the implementation of innovative methodologies
Main responsibilities:

• Subject matter expert (SME) for DS Biologics manufacturing.

• Process owner of DS Biologics validation for Sobi products.

• Lead and execute MSAT projects such as manufacturing process and cost improvement as part of life-cycle management (LCM).

• Participate in and lead internal activities related to (external) manufacturing such as process changes, major/critical deviations, risk assessments and CAPAs.

• Issue, review and approve applicable internal and external SOP’s and manufacturing instructions.

• Review and supervise set up, execution and documentation of technical studies, qualifications and validations.

• Write and review applicable sections of the APR/PQR.

• Write and review applicable sections in registration files, variations and market expansion, as well as answer Health authorities requests and questions.

• Support in sourcing evaluation of new DS Biologics contract manufacturers and participation in developing supply and quality agreements.

• Lead the process components of the product transfer, scale up activities, validations and oversee manufacturing of DS Biologics processes at external manufacturers for Sobi projects in clinical and commercial phase.

• Be aware of external pharmaceutical manufacturing technology advancements, understand and introduce new technologies and how they may be applicable to process innovation, cost or yield improvement

• Represent SAT in product governance teams as needed, including potentially coordinating the oversight and escalation of DS, DP and Analytical project portfolio.

• Support SAT and Sobi’s continuous improvement program for internal business processes, systems and templates.

• University education in Biology, Biotechnology, Pharmacy or similar.

• +10 years of experience of  manufacturing of DS Biologics for commercial use. Additional experience in clinical manufacturing and process development for clinical and commercial use is a plus.

• Strong background in Upstream Manufacturing (including Cell banking and new working cell bank implementation).  Mammalian Cell culture mainly  and bacterial fermentation a plus.

• Strong understanding of scale down models and their qualification a plus.

• Scientific and technical background of CMC development, product launch is a plus.

• Experience of regulatory guidelines, and regulatory authorities’ communication.

• Demonstrable experience of working in cross functional team with ability to multitask, prioritize and be an effective decision maker

• Ability to thrive in new, unstructured environments and influence without authority.

• Ability to act independently and take initiative

• Good communication skills, oral/written and listening

• Fluent in English.

• Travelling up to 30% of the time.

How to apply
We have an ongoing selection process in this recruitment and ask you to send your application as soon as possible. Click apply and include your resume in English.
Why Join Us?
Here at Sobi, our mission and culture get us excited to come to work every day, but here are a few more reasons to join our team:

• Emphasis on work/life balance

• Collaborative and team-oriented environment

• Opportunities for professional growth

• Diversity and Inclusion

• Competitive compensation for your work

• Making a positive impact to help ultra-rare disease patients who are in need of life saving treatments
We are a global company with over 1,900 employees in more than 30 countries and are committed to the societies where we operate. With a deeply skilled management team directing our day-to-day wins, and a Board with a stellar track record, we’re ready to take on the world’s diseases, ailments and adversity. Our people believe they have the power to make a positive impact in others’ lives because that’s exactly what we do here. If you’re seeking a career that taps into your talents in a way that makes the world a better, healthier place, we just may have a job for you.

We know our employees are our most valuable asset, and our culture conveys that. We offer a competitive benefits package, to support the health and happiness of our staff.

• Propriétaire du procédé de validation des produits biologiques DS pour Sobi.

jobs.description:
The Global Quality GVP Manager mission is toensure quality oversight and quality assurance activities related to GVP area and guide and support from a quality perspective the global and local, as applicable, PV activities within Sobi
 Key responsibilities include in particular:

• Contribute to the development of the audit strategy & program and plans related to the GVP area-PV processes, vendors, Partners and affiliates

• Act as a GVP Audit Program Owner when delegated by Global Quality GCP/GVP Head

• Perform and coordinate PV audits internally and externally and act whenever needed as delegated by Global Quality GCP/GVP Head

• Support and collaborate with GPV organization and the safety interfaces such as Medical Affairs, Regulatory Affairs and Affiliates, as applicable

• Ensure qualification of global and local ESP, as applicable in GVP regulated area per Sobi procedures

• Act as QA representative in PV Inspections and different initiatives or projects as needed

• Ensure GVP Audits management excellence of the end-to-end audit management process and overview of the assigned audits, as planned

• Assess and approve from quality perspective the PV deviations (global and local, as applicable), PV related CAPAs.

• Prepare regular status report on performed audits, audit trending, PV deviation trending, PV CAPAs, trending and agreed upon metrics to ensure Quality oversight.

• Ensure the updates needed for audit related information to the PSMF and participate actively to the QPPV extended meeting.

• Contribute to the GVP audit strategy according to SOPs.

• Prepare GVP Audit annual plans according to SOPs, ensuring the risk assessment and prioritization of the GVP Audits are performed in collaboration with GPV organization and with GVP Audit program owner

• Authoring GVP QA related processes, review and approve the PV related SOPs (or SOPs from other RDMA and Quality areas with implicit or interfaced PV activities eg Medical information, regulatory, medical affairs, compassionate use)

• Ensure active contribution in the cross functional team with procurement and business owners for GVP requirements and documented QA qualification of GVP service providers and review PV provision in contracts/Quality agreements, as applicable

• QA representative during PV inspections and partner audits and promote the Inspection Readiness framework and continuously quality mindset across Sobi.

• University degree in Life Sciences or related discipline.

• At least 5 year experience from the pharmaceutical industry with GVP responsibilities, and audit management and/or Quality Assurance experience

• Excellent knowhow of the EU/US/RoW regulations within GVP as well as Quality assurance activities principles and know-how

• Documented education/experience in QA systems and preferably auditing

• Structured approach with strong focus on results and highly detai-oriented orientation

• Strong interpersonal skills with communicative and flexible attitude

• Proactive and collaborative mindset with a strong multi-tasking abilities and a high resilience and adaptative skills

• You should live up to our core values: Ambition,Ownership, Urgency, Partnership and Care

jobs.description:
Support the Director of Market Access to develop and execute market access strategies that enable optimal launch, pricing, reimbursement, and sustainable access to a specialty care indications across international markets and designated partner regions. The role requires strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and solid knowledge of international market access policies, health economics, and stakeholder engagement to deliver timely and equitable patient access.
 Main responsibilities

• Planning: Support development and implementation of comprehensive market access strategies tailored to launching Specialty care product, diverse international markets and partner regions, aligned with corporate objectives, regulatory landscapes, and local affiliate needs.

• Pricing and reimbursement: Collaborate to secure pricing, reimbursement, and formulary inclusion for new and existing products, leveraging health economic models, budget impact analyses, and value-based arguments.

• Evidence and value communication: Support the development of HEOR evidence, real-world data (RWD), and global/local value dossiers to inform HTA submissions and payer negotiations; contribute to objection handlers and payer negotiation materials.

• Stakeholder engagement: Build and maintain compliant relationships with external stakeholders (payers, HTA agencies, partners, regulatory bodies, and patient advocacy groups) to facilitate access, inform strategy, and shape evidence needs.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with global and local Medical, Commercial, Regulatory, Legal, and Government Affairs teams to synchronize market access initiatives, share best practices, and ensure launch readiness.

• Policy monitoring and advocacy: Monitor policy developments and trends across international and partner regions; proactively identify risks and opportunities and support advocacy efforts that enhance patient access.

• Project leadership and operations: Manage multiple concurrent market access projects, ensuring timely delivery, budget adherence, risk management, and measurable outcomes; oversee vendor activities where relevant.

• Reporting and metrics: Track, analyse, and report on access performance, milestones (e.g., HTA outcomes, P&R decisions), and competitive intelligence across assigned regions; maintain accurate, timely updates in PRISMA, Smartsheet, and other internal systems.

• Education: Advanced degree in life sciences, pharmacy, public health, economics, or related field (PhD, MSc, MBA preferred).

• 7+ years in market access and reimbursement within international region role, focusing on GI, internal medicine, endocrinology, Cardiovascular and rare disease market access, with strong understanding for both niche and large patient populations reimbursement.

• Proven track record in international launch planning and execution, including access strategy development with payers and policy makers networks for both niche and large populations markets.

• Effective track record working in matrixed, multicultural teams across different regions.

• Good understanding of international healthcare systems, HTA processes, and both public and private payers’ environment.

• Fluent English; additional languages desirable.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sostenere il Direttore di Market Access per sviluppare ed eseguire strategie di accesso al mercato che consentano il lancio ottimale, i prezzi, il rimborso e l'accesso sostenibile ad un'indicazione di assistenza specializzata in mercati internazionali e regioni partner designate. Il ruolo richiede un pensiero strategico, una collaborazione interfunzionale e una solida conoscenza delle politiche di accesso al mercato internazionale, dell'economia sanitaria e dell'impegno degli stakeholder per offrire un accesso tempestivo ed equo ai pazienti.
Principali responsabilità

• Pianificazione: Sostenere lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di strategie di accesso al mercato complete su misura per lanciare prodotti di assistenza, mercati internazionali e regioni partner diversi, allineati con obiettivi aziendali, paesaggi normativi e esigenze di affiliazione locali.

• Prezzo e rimborso: Collaborare per garantire prezzi, rimborso e inclusione di formule per prodotti nuovi e esistenti, sfruttando modelli economici per la salute, analisi degli impatti di bilancio e argomenti basati sul valore.

• Prove e comunicazione di valore: Sostenere lo sviluppo di prove HEOR, dati reali (RWD), e dossier di valore globali/locali per informare le presentazioni HTA e i negoziati di pagamento; contribuire a gestire le obiezioni e materiali di negoziazione dei pagamenti.

• Impegno degli stakeholder: Costruire e mantenere relazioni conformi con gli stakeholder esterni (payers, agenzie HTA, partner, enti normativi e gruppi di advocacy dei pazienti) per facilitare l'accesso, informare la strategia e modellare le esigenze delle prove.

• Collaborazione interfunzionale: Partner con i team globali e locali di Affari medici, commerciali, regolamentari, legali e governativi per sincronizzare le iniziative di accesso al mercato, condividere le migliori pratiche e garantire la disponibilità al lancio.

• Monitoraggio e advocacy delle politiche: Monitorare gli sviluppi politici e le tendenze nelle regioni internazionali e partner; identificare proattivamente i rischi e le opportunità e sostenere gli sforzi di advocacy che migliorano l'accesso dei pazienti.

• Leader del progetto e operazioni: Gestire più progetti di accesso al mercato concomitante, garantire la consegna tempestiva, l'aderenza di bilancio, la gestione del rischio e risultati misurabili; supervisionare le attività del fornitore in caso di pertinenza.

• Reporting e metriche: Tracciare, analizzare e segnalare le prestazioni di accesso, le pietre miliari (ad esempio, i risultati HTA, le decisioni P&R), e l'intelligenza competitiva nelle regioni assegnate; mantenere aggiornamenti accurati e tempestivi in PRISMA, Smartsheet e altri sistemi interni.

• Istruzione: Laurea avanzata in scienze della vita, farmacia, sanità pubblica, economia o campo relativo (PhD, MSc, MBA preferito).

• 7+ anni di accesso al mercato e di rimborso all'interno del ruolo della regione internazionale, concentrandosi su GI, medicina interna, endocrinologia, accesso al mercato delle malattie cardiovascolari e rare, con una forte comprensione per il rimborso delle popolazioni sia di nicchia che di grandi pazienti.

• Provato track record nella pianificazione e nell'esecuzione del lancio internazionale, tra cui lo sviluppo di strategia di accesso con i finanziatori e le reti di responsabili politici sia per i mercati di nicchia e grandi popolazioni.

• Efficace track record di lavoro in squadre matrici e multiculturali in diverse regioni.

• Buona comprensione dei sistemi sanitari internazionali, dei processi HTA e dell’ambiente pubblico e privato dei contribuenti.

• Inglese fluente; lingue aggiuntive desiderabili.

Tutte le tue informazioni saranno mantenute riservate secondo le linee guida EEO.

Aider le directeur de l'accès aux marchés à élaborer et à mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'accès aux marchés qui permettent un lancement optimal, des prix, des remboursements et un accès durable à des indications de soins spécialisés sur les marchés internationaux et les régions partenaires désignées. Le rôle exige une réflexion stratégique, une collaboration interfonctionnelle et une solide connaissance des politiques internationales d'accès aux marchés, de l'économie de la santé et de l'engagement des intervenants afin d'offrir un accès rapide et équitable aux patients.
Principales responsabilités

• Planification : Appuyer l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies globales d'accès aux marchés adaptées au lancement de produits de soins spécialisés, de divers marchés internationaux et de régions partenaires, conformément aux objectifs de l'entreprise, aux paysages réglementaires et aux besoins locaux des filiales.

• Tarification et remboursement : Collaborer pour assurer l'inclusion des prix, des remboursements et des formules pour les produits nouveaux et existants, en tirant parti des modèles économiques de la santé, des analyses d'impact budgétaire et des arguments fondés sur la valeur.

• Communication de données et de valeurs : Appuyer la mise au point de données HEOR, de données sur le monde réel et de dossiers de valeurs mondiales/locales pour éclairer les soumissions de HTA et les négociations avec les payeurs; contribuer au traitement des objections et aux documents de négociation avec les payeurs.

• Engagement des intervenants : Établir et maintenir des relations conformes avec les intervenants externes (payeurs, organismes de HTA, partenaires, organismes de réglementation et groupes de défense des patients) afin de faciliter l'accès, d'éclairer la stratégie et de façonner les besoins en matière de données probantes.

• Collaboration interfonctionnelle : S'associer à des équipes mondiales et locales des affaires médicales, commerciales, réglementaires, juridiques et gouvernementales pour synchroniser les initiatives d'accès aux marchés, partager les meilleures pratiques et assurer le lancement.

• Suivi des politiques et sensibilisation : suivre l'évolution des politiques et les tendances dans les régions internationales et partenaires; identifier les risques et les possibilités et appuyer les efforts de sensibilisation qui améliorent l'accès des patients.

• Leadership et opérations du projet : Gérer plusieurs projets d'accès aux marchés en même temps, assurer l'exécution en temps opportun, l'observation du budget, la gestion des risques et des résultats mesurables; superviser les activités des fournisseurs au besoin.

• Rapports et mesures : suivre, analyser et rendre compte du rendement en matière d'accès, des jalons (p. ex. résultats de l'ACS, décisions en matière de R et R) et de l'information concurrentielle dans les régions désignées; tenir à jour en temps opportun les systèmes PRISMA, Smartsheet et autres systèmes internes.

• Études : Diplôme supérieur en sciences de la vie, pharmacie, santé publique, économie ou domaine connexe (Ph.D., M.Sc., M.B.A. préféré).

• 7 ans et plus d'accès au marché et de remboursement au sein de la région internationale, en mettant l'accent sur l'IG, la médecine interne, l'endocrinologie, l'accès au marché des maladies cardiovasculaires et rares, avec une forte compréhension pour le remboursement des patients niches et grands.

• Expérience éprouvée dans la planification et l'exécution des lancements internationaux, y compris l'élaboration de stratégies d'accès avec les payeurs et les réseaux de décideurs pour les marchés de niche et les grands marchés de populations.

• Travail efficace dans les équipes multiculturelles matricielles de différentes régions.

• Bonne compréhension des systèmes de soins de santé internationaux, des processus HTA et de l'environnement des payeurs publics et privés.

Sobi-Kultur
